opportunities.name: Full automation of email order processing
opportunities.description: Automatically detect order emails in Gmail, extract key fields (customer, product, quantity, address), log them in Google Sheets, check stock, and send confirmation — without human intervention for standard cases.

effort.label: Low
effort.rationale: Native tools available (Gmail Trigger + Google Sheets in n8n). Main complexity: extracting fields from a natural-language email body (Code node + LLM prompt). 4–6h of freelance work estimated.

impact.label: Very high
impact.rationale: Eliminates ~30 min/day of copy-paste + missed confirmations. Improves customer reliability. Direct, visible ROI impact from week one.

roi.confidence_note: Time saved depends on the actual format of incoming emails. If 30% require human validation, actual gain is ~70% of the estimate.

opportunities.name: Proactive pre-confirmation out-of-stock alert
opportunities.description: Before sending the confirmation to the customer, check stock level in Google Sheets in real time. If out of stock: do not send the confirmation, send an alert to Marc and Julien, set order status to 'To handle'. Eliminate confirmations sent in error followed by cancellations.

effort.label: Low
effort.rationale: Integrates into the OPP01 workflow as a conditional branch (IF node). No additional system required.

impact.label: High
impact.rationale: Eliminates crisis management (45 min × 2–3/month) and preserves the customer relationship. Major qualitative impact on retention.

roi.confidence_note: Depends on Delphine regularly updating stock in Google Sheets — a necessary condition that is not itself automated.

opportunities.name: Automated weekly invoicing
opportunities.description: Every Friday, automatically generate PDF invoices for all orders of the week from the Google Sheet, number them sequentially, and email them to customers.

effort.label: Medium
effort.rationale: Requires either an invoicing tool (Pennylane, Invoice Ninja) or PDF generation via script (Google Apps Script or n8n + template). More complex than a simple email trigger.

impact.label: High
impact.rationale: 2h/week × 48 weeks = 96h/year recovered. Purely repetitive task with no added value for Marc.

roi.confidence_note: Cost and timeline vary by tool chosen. VAT-exempt status keeps accounting complexity low — favourable for simple automation.

opportunities.name: Automatic follow-up for missing address
opportunities.description: When an order email is received without a shipping address, automatically send a follow-up email to the customer asking for the address, and put the order on hold in Google Sheets.

effort.label: Very low
effort.rationale: Extension of the OPP01 workflow: one additional IF branch on the missing 'address' field.

impact.label: Moderate
impact.rationale: Affects 30% of orders. Reduces manual back-and-forth and smooths the process, but the absolute time impact is limited.

roi.time_saved_calculation: 2500 orders × 30% without address × 2 min manual follow-up / 60
roi.confidence_note: Requires the workflow to detect a missing address — depends on OPP01 extraction quality.

recommended_sequence.rationale: OPP01 is the core of the workflow. OPP02 and OPP04 are natural extensions — they are built at the same time at no significant additional cost.
Once the main workflow is stable (2–4 weeks of operation), add automated invoicing.

pipeline_breaks_detected.description: Stock updated end-of-day by Delphine — morning orders are validated against previous-day data
pipeline_breaks_detected.recommended_fix: Either Delphine updates stock in real time, or the workflow automatically marks orders 'Pending stock check' for Marc to confirm manually

pipeline_breaks_detected.description: Order number incremented manually — risk of duplicates between email orders and PrestaShop orders
pipeline_breaks_detected.recommended_fix: Use a prefix to distinguish email orders (e.g. 'ML-2026-001') from PrestaShop orders
